script_text: Stop, Aquarius — Pluto is directly on your Sun in your 1st House right now, igniting a total identity shift the universe won't wait for. Saturn in Taurus forms a heavy opposition from your 4th House of Home, pressuring your foundations or a family decision that cannot be postponed. Your Air sign nature wants to float above it, but Uranus — your ruling planet — demands you face reality and rebuild with intention. In love, Mars charges through your 7th House of Partnerships, creating magnetic but volatile energy. If taken, watch for ego clashes. If single, someone commanding enters your orbit this week. For career and money, Jupiter's trine to your natal Sun activates your 3rd House of communication — a deal or contract lands soon. Don't let fear of upheaval steal the power Pluto is handing you.
